messages:
incidents-bot: PagerDuty alert fired: INC-2026 -> metrics_ingest_kafka_lag_high. Severity: P1. Auto-paging eng-sre oncall. Link: https://pagerduty.example/INC-2026

jordan: ack - taking it. Any customer impact reported?

pagerduty-bot: ack recorded by jordan (oncall). Escalation policy will call if not acknowledged in 2m.

lee: I'm oncall too, jumping in. Seeing a big surge on logs-ingest consumers in prod — kafka consumer lag ~120k on topic redwood-logs.

sam: also seeing Prometheus scrape errors spike for job=redwood-collector across many targets: frequent "connection timeout" and 5xx.

jordan: grabbing current metrics. Scrape_failure_count spiked, log_queue_depth high. Could be consumer stalls or upstream broker IO.

maria: ops reported 3 customers with realtime-search failures (~503). Impact: degraded for a subset of traffic.

lee: quick k8s check — some ingest-worker pods are CrashLooping. Output: 
```
$ kubectl -n prod get pods -l app=ingest-worker
ingest-worker-1    CrashLoopBackOff   1/1   32m
ingest-worker-2    Running            1/1   6m
ingest-worker-3    Running            1/1   6m
```

sam: logs show repeated consumer timeouts: 
```
[2026-03-14T21:12:03Z] ERROR ingest - consumer.poll timed out after 30000ms; processed=0; partitions stalled=[redwood-logs-3]
```

jordan: any OOM or GC spikes in those pods?

sam: seeing long GC pauses around the same time, plus "offsets committed behind consumer group" in logs.

maria: confirmed: billing pipeline delayed but not failing. Only realtime search returning 503s for some customers.

lee: mitigation options: 1) restart stuck pod to clear consumer lock 2) scale up consumer replicas to drain lag 3) divert writes to backup topic while we investigate broker health.

jordan: low-risk first: restart ingest-worker-1. Lee, can you do that? If no improvement, we scale.

lee: doing restart now: `kubectl -n prod delete pod ingest-worker-1` — deleting pod...

incidents-bot: Action recorded: pod ingest-worker-1 deleted by lee.

sam: pod restarted, rejoined consumer group. Throughput up ~20% but lag still ~90k.

maria: customer errors reduced slightly but still present. I'll queue a customer update in 15m if this doesn't resolve.

jordan: next step: scale replicas and tune consumer config (max.poll.records) to increase throughput. I'm applying HPA now to raise max replicas.

lee: applying HPA patch: 
```
kubectl apply -f - <<EOF
apiVersion: autoscaling/v2
kind: HorizontalPodAutoscaler
metadata:
  name: ingest-worker-hpa
  namespace: prod
spec:
  scaleTargetRef:
    apiVersion: apps/v1
    kind: Deployment
    name: ingest-worker
  minReplicas: 3
  maxReplicas: 8
EOF
```

incidents-bot: HPA change recorded by lee.

sam: after scaling to 8 replicas, consumer throughput doubled. Lag down to ~12k and prom scrape errors decreasing.

jordan: good progress. Maria, set customer impact to "partial degraded" and open follow-up.

maria: on it. Creating customer incident ticket and drafting comms.

ops-lead: Jordan — if lag doesn't drop below 5k in 30m, escalate to Tier2 and collect JVM GC logs + thread dumps from ingest-workers for deeper triage.

jordan: Roger. Collecting GC logs and thread dumps now; will attach to the PD incident.

lee: note: we rolled a consumer config change yesterday (max.poll.records tweak). Rolling back that change to canary now to validate.

sam: rollback on canary successful. Monitoring metrics.

pagerduty-bot: PagerDuty escalation: oncall-tier2 notified due to sustained lag at 21:50Z.

jordan: final update before I hand off primary — lag trending down, customer errors dropping. Handing primary monitoring to lee for 30m. If anything spikes @ops-lead please call me. :thumbsup:

lee: taking primary. Monitoring dashboards and logs.

maria: customer comms sent: "We're aware of degraded search and are mitigating. Next update in 30 minutes." :email: 

jordan: closing PD incident to monitoring state while we watch. Leaving this thread open for follow-up.

incidents-bot: Incident note: status set to MONITORING by jordan."
